implementation.queuePolicy: Screen repair output is held as UTF-8 byte-accounted chunks under Math.min(runtimePtyConfig.maxSnapshotBytes, 262144) and resourceLimits.headless.pendingOutputMaxChunks.
implementation.recovery: Overflow, timeout, write failure, and authority faults abort the old repair token and choose exactly one client-local fresh snapshot or reconnect-required outcome.
implementation.sequence: Fresh authoritative snapshot coverage drops only chunks with a proven screen sequence at or below snapshot.seq; unknown or newer chunks remain an exactly-once ordered tail.
implementation.safeSend: Superseded repair, restore, snapshot, and transaction-tagged session:ready frames are removed from the affected session queue while unrelated session order and lane counters are preserved.
implementation.privacy: Telemetry records byte/chunk/sequence/token/reason/outcome/source metadata only and does not persist raw terminal payload.
